interpretation: For permit NM0020583 limit row 3610839677 (parameter 22416, Whole effluent toxicity - retest #2), the concentration-max DMR field carries a binary pass/fail indicator for the second required acute WET retest of Pimephales promelas, not a numeric effluent concentration. Report 0 when the 48-hour acute NOEC for survival is at or above the 23% critical dilution (pass); report 1 when the NOEC is below the critical dilution (fail). This row is used only when a retest sequence is triggered after an initial test failure; compliance is evaluated against the critical-dilution pass/fail criterion, not against an ordinary numeric limit value.
grounding: Authoritative permit text in documents/farmington/final_permit.txt (Part II, Section D.3) assigns STORET code 22416 to Pimephales promelas Retest 2 and defines the 0/1 encoding relative to the 23% critical dilution. Structured permit_limits.csv row 3610839677 repeats PASS=0/FAIL=1 and directs reporting in CONCENTRATION MAX (STATISTICAL_BASE_TYPE_CODE MAX), consistent with the permit table.

remaining_uncertainty: The workspace establishes the encoding and biological meaning of 0 and 1 for this parameter but does not, from DMR data alone, establish whether a second retest was required or performed in any specific FY2025 monitoring period (FY2025 DMR rows for 22416 have no reported values). Frequency-reduction conditions referenced in the limit comment are a separate monitoring-schedule question.
